items.title: Vince Giordano interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: Pops Foster played one for a while, John Kirby did for a while

ctx.x: And so many basses that you might have seen in pictures might have been aluminum basses. Pops Foster played one for a while, John Kirby did for a while, and there are different makes and different models and some are better than others. And I, just as a novelty I just stripped off all the paint so it’s naked aluminum. And I get so many people who come to me and say, “what’s with this?” And I say — oh and I have our violinist play a phono-fiddle, which is a violin with a horn, for occasional numbers. And again…
